title: Surveying Walking Person
description: Reusable deterministic surveying-field person with straight-path, speed, height, and gait-frequency controls.
learningObjectives: Relate walking speed, elapsed time, and path distance in a surveying-field context.
Reuse a deterministic animated person without coupling it to a complete lesson.

rights.attribution: Original LearnMat repository contribution; no third-party visual assets or runtime dependencies.

verification.notes: Distance/time and endpoint invariants reviewed from source. Browser and assistive-technology checks remain for independent review.
